item.title: Kabaka’s Eid Message Urges Faith to Translate into Civic Responsibility and National Unity
item.description: At Kibuli Mosque, First Deputy Katikkiro Hajji Twaha Kaawaase Kigongo delivered a message from Kabaka Ronald Mutebi, presenting Eid al-Fitr not only as a religious celebration but also as a civic call to action. item.title: Treasury PS Ggoobi Urges Muslims to Pray for Peace and Unity for Uganda’s Development
item.description: The Permanent Secretary to the Treasury, Ramathan Ggoobi, has called on the Muslim community to pray for peace and unity in Uganda, emphasizing their importance for the country’s social and economic development. item.title: Mufti Mubaje Appeals for Dialogue Amid Iran Crisis, Calls for Support for Flood-Affected Traders
item.description: The Mufti of Uganda, Sheikh Shaban Ramadhan Mubaje, has called for dialogue to protect innocent lives caught in the ongoing conflict in Iran. item.title: NRM Releases Roadmap for EALA By-Elections to Fill Two Vacant Seats
item.description: The ruling National Resistance Movement (NRM) has unveiled the official roadmap for by-elections to fill two vacant seats in the 5th East African Legislative Assembly (EALA). item.description: Traffic Police have attributed a series of fatal accidents last week to speeding and reckless overtaking, which continue to endanger lives on Uganda’s roads.
